name: b11870
body:
<details open>

model: DSV4.1 flash (#31086)

* model : add DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (deepseek41)

* deepseek41 : remove MXFP8, convert the Engram table to BF16

* deepseek41 : compute the compressed-KV read layers once in the cache

* deepseek41 : use get_cells() for the shared-history check, drop llama_kv_cache::seq_pos_tok_le

* deepseek41 : gather the Engram rows in-graph like qwen4exp, drop the host gather

* deepseek41 : keep the Engram hash constants in hparams.ple_*, one module per Engram layer

* deepseek41 : drop the LLAMA_DSV41_KV_MIRROR toggle

* deepseek41 : keep il last in build_hc_mixes

* deepseek41 : sort the top-k rows before the sparse gather

* tests : add deepseek41 to the Metal fusion baseline

---------

Co-authored-by: Daniel Han <danielhanchen@gmail.com>

</details>
